description:
Return the printable rendering of a document, as a PDF.

Works for both types — a DANFE for nfe, a DANFSe for nfse. The PDF
comes back base64-encoded in content_base64, with its size in
size_bytes; the XML, not this, is the legally valid document. A
PDF above 2 MB is not inlined: the answer says to download it from
the API instead. A 502 from here means the authorizer is
unavailable, not that the invoice is wrong.

access_key.description: The access key (chave de acesso) the authorizer assigned, as issue_invoice and list_invoices return it. An NF-e key has 44 characters; the issuer's CNPJ inside it may carry letters since July 2026, so copy it exactly.

company_id.description: UUID of the company this call acts for. Omit it when the connection covers a single company; with several it is required (see list_authorized_companies). Send company_id or company_tax_id, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company this call acts for, never the recipient or a taxpayer being looked up. Omit it when the connection covers a single company; with several it is required (see list_authorized_companies). Send company_id or company_tax_id, never both.

document_type.description: nfse for a service invoice, nfe for goods.

name: get_invoice_pdf

outputSchema.description: A printed document, base64-encoded because a tool answer is JSON.

content_base64.description: The PDF bytes, base64-encoded. Decode before saving.

size_bytes.description: Size of the decoded PDF, in bytes.
